home.headline: Long light on the Vale
home.sub: Pick a mode, take your side of the dial, and fight for the hour you want to keep.

feature.title: Three roads, one Hourbell
feature.body: Draft five fighters, hold the Dialwood and silence the enemy Hourbell on Hourfall. Matches run about 25 minutes.

tiles.title: Ranked season
tiles.body: Ranked RIFT opens at account level 20. Your first 5 matches place you on the ladder.

tiles.title: The Almanac
tiles.body: A season of rewards is being written. It is not open yet.

tiles.title: Sparring practice
tiles.body: Try any fighter alone on the full map. Add gold and levels, set up training targets, refresh cooldowns.

tiles.title: Your collection
tiles.body: Every fighter is free to play. Skins change how a fighter looks, never how they play.

tips: By default, allies glow azure and enemies glow marigold on every map. Settings let you change both.
A glow on an enemy fighter is a warning. When their light flares, an ability is on its way.
Enemy danger areas are brightest at the edge. Step out before the circle closes.
Hold the scoreboard key to see every fighter's items and levels. Let go and it closes.
Unspent Gleam fights for no one. Recall when you can afford a full item.
Recall takes about 7 s. Start it somewhere an enemy cannot reach in that time.
Needlegrass hides you from enemies outside it. An enemy standing in the same grass can still see you.
A Needle's shadow ring shows how far it can strike. Stay outside it unless you mean to break it.
A Lantern holds a road's stored light. When it falls, your team gains Lanternwake until it relights 4:00 later.
The Glasshorn gives your whole team Clearglass for 90 s: faster cooldowns and quicker Light regeneration.
The Resinback gives your team Resinburn for 90 s. Basic attacks on fighters burn and slow them briefly.
Each Sunsplinter you take adds a Splinter for your team. Longshade, late in the match, gives the living team the Long Shade for sieging.
Your ultimate unlocks at level 6, then ranks up at levels 11 and 16.
BRIDGE has no recall. Take the Mending Sunmotes that fall on the span, and shop at home or while you wait to return.
In BRIDGE, a swap sends your fighter to the Lot for a teammate to take. You can also draw again once.
FRAY gives you four lives. First to 12 takedowns or the last one standing wins, and the Hour Board ranks the rest.
The Lampwright cart on the Noonplate is shared by all ten. Shop between fights, not during them.
Physical damage numbers are chalk and magic damage numbers are orchid-rose. Armor shrinks the first, resist the second.
Numerals in ink with a pale halo are damage that ignores armor and resist.
Pings are how your team talks. Say what you see before the fight, not during it.
After a fall, the recap lists the damage you took in the last 15 s. Read it once, then carry on.
Your first win of each day pays a bonus on top of the usual Candles.
Ranked opens at account level 20. Until then, Quick and Draft are the places to learn.
Quick cast fires an ability the moment you press its key. Turn it on under Settings, Controls.
Colourblind modes change the ally and enemy colours and add a shape to each. Find them under Settings, Accessibility.
